abstract_sentences.text: Hard attention Chain-of-Thought (CoT) transformers are known to be Turing-complete.

evidence.anchor: Hard attention Chain-of-Thought transformers are known to be Turing-complete.

abstract_sentences.text: However, it is an open problem whether softmax attention Chain-of-Thought (CoT) transformers are Turing-complete.

evidence.anchor: open problem whether softmax attention Chain-of-Thought transformers are Turing-complete.

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we prove a stronger result that length-generalizable softmax CoT transformers are Turing-complete.

evidence.anchor: length-generalizable softmax CoT transformers are Turing-complete.

abstract_sentences.text: More precisely, our Turing-completeness proof goes via the CoT extension of the Counting RASP (C-RASP), which correspond to softmax CoT transformers that admit length generalization.

evidence.anchor: proof goes via the CoT extension of the Counting RASP (C-RASP).

abstract_sentences.text: We prove Turing-completeness for CoT C-RASP with causal masking over a unary alphabet (more generally, for letter-bounded languages).

evidence.anchor: over a unary alphabet (more generally, for letter-bounded languages).

abstract_sentences.text: While we show this is not Turing-complete for arbitrary languages, we prove that its extension with relative positional encoding is Turing-complete for arbitrary languages.

evidence.anchor: not Turing-complete for arbitrary languages; its extension with relative positional encoding.

abstract_sentences.text: We empirically validate our theory by training transformers for languages requiring complex (non-linear) arithmetic reasoning.

evidence.anchor: empirically validate our theory by training transformers for languages requiring complex arithmetic reasoning.
what task can (and cannot) be done by CoT transformers?

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以 C-RASP 的 counting power 替代 softmax 难以可靠定位 head 的直接 Turing-machine simulation：CoT counter machine 先覆盖 NoPE 受限语言，再用固定任务无关 RPE 的 β/μ/σ 编码覆盖任意语言，最后经 Proposition 2.1 连接到 length-generalizable softmax CoT SMAT。（p.2、p.6–9）
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 SMAT/C-RASP/CoT 接口、NoPE 正负边界、RPE 构造概览、Eq. (1)–(12)、parity Figure 1、Table 1 和五任务的三 regime 对比；这些对象共同承担决策。（p.2–10）
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整 expressiveness/learnability proofs、RPE literature mapping、letter-bounded/Phase II/NFA proof、dataset construction、EM/loss mask、ReLU 改造和 Table 3 hyperparameters 移到 Appendix A–D；理论可读性保留，严格 proof 与复现自足性下降。（p.14–21）
final_judgment.best_pattern: 先主动给出 Proposition 4.1/Lemma 4.2 的 NoPE failure boundary，再给出同一问题的 fixed-RPE encoding repair；Figure 1→Eq. (5)–(6) 和 Table 1 的成功/失败 regime 让抽象保证有可追踪视觉与数值锚点。（p.6–10）
final_judgment.largest_gap: RPE ablation 不是 capacity-matched：BinaryR 为 1 layer/1 head/64 dim，BinaryN 为 6 layer/4 head/256 dim；同时没有 seeds、分母、不确定性或逐步 trace failures，因此 binary “requires RPE” 的经验机制归因仍属部分闭合。（p.10、p.20–21）
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 形式化论文应先显式给出能力边界，再让同一构造对象在正例、反例和修复实验中反复出现；主表应并列成功与失败 regime，而不是只展示成功案例。（p.1–10）
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有清晰可执行构造的理论/系统论文；一旦结论包含组件因果归因，仍必须匹配容量、优化、seed、数据分母与失败模式，不能用不同规模模型代替单变量消融。（p.10、p.19–21）
